The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.The following full-/part-time position (38.5/19.5 hours per week)  is to be filled as soon as possible in the Institute for Hygiene and Public Health, Section Global Child Health of the University Hospital Bonn:Scientific coordinator (m/f/d)The Section of Global Child Health was established in November 2025 with the appointment of the Endowed Professorship in Global Child Health. The Section’s remit includes research and teaching in Germany and internationally, as well as clinical practice and the applied, practice-oriented engagement with global health challenges affecting children and adolescents. The professorship is structured as a tandem appointment with a corresponding position at the University of Malawi, based in Lilongwe.You will work in close collaboration with the section head in establishing sound research and communication networks with partners in Malawi and GermanyThe professorship focuses on research in the area of neonatal, child, and adolescent health in “Low and Middle Income Countries” (LMICs), identifies barriers to and solutions for improving global child health, and facilitates the transfer of epidemiological and clinical evidence into health care services with the goal of improving the health status of all children globally.It facilitates institutional, national and international networking and collaboration with universities, academic institutions and key development partners.In addition, it provides academic and health policy advice to national and international governmental as well as non-governmental organizations with regard to global child health.The position is initially limited to three years and remunerated according to TV-L EG 13 (German tax ID is a prerequisite). If you currently live abroad, you should be willing to relocate to Germany temporarily. Subject to interest and feasibility, a temporary increase in the scope of employment through third-party funded resources is envisaged.Tasks:This position offers the opportunity to actively contribute to the development of global strategies for improving children's health and to build and design a completely new international research and education structure.- Strategic coordination and management of international research, education and clinical programmes across the two professorships and the EKFS network- Planning, coordination, and monitoring of cross-institutional activities with academic and non-academic partners- Management of communication channels between institutions, disciplines, and countries, ensuring efficient information flow and alignment of activities- Coordination, and implementation of training materials and structured capacity-building programmes in collaboration with international experts- Planning, organisation, and delivery of international workshops and seminars in online and on-site formats- Preparation of annual progress and impact reports, dissemination of results through conferences and other scientific communication formats- Contribution to the strategic development, coordination, and drafting of third-party funding proposals to expand and sustain programme activitiesRequirements:- A full academic degree at Master’s level or higher in a health-related discipline- A strong interest in global child health and international health systems cooperation- Demonstrated experience in project coordination and research management- Excellent organisational skills and a structured, meticulous approach to work- Proven ability to navigate academic hierarchies and university administrative processes, combined with sensitivity to intercultural contexts- Strong teamwork skills, resilience, and the ability to assert and represent set positions- Full professional proficiency in both German and English, written and spoken Willingness to maintain an appropriate on-site presence at the university in Bonn- Previous extended study, research, or professional experience in a low- or middle-income country would be considered a strong assetWe offer: An interesting and challenging job in a modern research institution with attractive research infrastructures and a cooperative and communicative institute culture. This includes:- **Responsible and diverse: **A position with significant scope for initiative and development within a truly collegial and supportive team- **Fair compensation: **Pay according to the TV-L collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme- **Family-friendly flexibility: **Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave- **Smart commuting: **Excellent connection to the SWB public transport network and the option of an interest-free loan for the purchase of an e-bike- **Supported development: **Individual training opportunities through courses, e-learning programs, and coaching sessions- **Structured onboarding: **A systematic introduction to your new role and team- **Healthy at work: **A wide range of health and wellness programs, plus free membership at the UKB fitness studio- **Employee benefits: **Access to discounted offers for employees (corporate benefits)We are committed to diversity and equal opportunities. Our goal is to increase the proportion of women in areas where women are underrepresented and to particularly promote their careers. We therefore urge relevantly qualified women to apply. Applications are treated in accordance with the State Equal Opportunities Act. Applications from suitable people with proven severe disabilities and those of equal status are particularly welcome.How to apply:If you are seeking a challenging and internationally oriented position within a leading research and clinical environment, we would be pleased to hear from you. For further information, please feel free to contact us.Please submit your complete application documents by 28/02/2026, quoting the vacancy reference number [ST-37032], as a single PDF file (maximum size 5 MB), by email to the address below.English is the working language in many areas of the position; sound knowledge of German is required for administrative issues. Support services for international applicants may be available, including guidance on visa and residence matters as well as initial orientation and integration. Information on dual career options and local infrastructure can be provided upon request.Prof. Dr. med. Help secure reliable operations today — and support the transition into LEO Pharma’s future production setup.

At LEO Pharma, we go beyond the skin to make a lasting difference for people living with skin diseases. Behind that mission is a strong technical foundation, and in this role, you will help ensure that foundation is reliable, compliant and future-ready.

Join LEO Pharma in Ballerup and take on a key technical role at an exciting time of change. As Maintenance Support Professional, you will help keep critical technical installations running, support compliance-based maintenance, and contribute to the proper and structured close-down of the old factory as we prepare for a new innovative production facility to fully take over.

**

Your role**

You will provide technical support for the planning, implementation and development of maintenance across utilities, technical installations, plants and production equipment at Site Ballerup. You will act as a technical problem-solver, resolve technical issues in daily operations while also supporting larger transformation activities related to the factory transition.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Supporting day-to-day operation and availability of both the old and newest state of the art technical installations and equipment.

• Acting as troubleshooter on ad hoc technical assignments, breakdowns and operational challenges.

• Ensuring maintenance documentation is maintained, optimized and aligned with LEO Pharma policies and GxP requirements.

• Creating, Reviewing and technically approving documents in QMS in close collaboration with stakeholders.

• Supporting the structured close-down of the old factory and contributing to a smooth transition towards the new facility.

You will also be responsible for GxP documentation from the section, including documentation in CMMS and QMS. In addition, you will support timely follow-up on deviations, corrective actions, action items and CAPAs, and act as technical SME in root cause analysis related to deviation handling. You may also participate in relevant CAPEX projects as participant or package owner and lead smaller OPEX projects.

**

Your qualifications**

We imagine that you bring solid technical expertise, good documentation discipline and experience from a regulated environment. You are used to working across functions and can communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.

We are looking for someone with:

• An educational background as an engineer, marine engineer, process technician or equivalent.

• 5+ years’ experience with maintenance of utilities, technical installations, plants or production equipment.

• Hands-on experience with deviation handling, root cause analysis, CAPAs or similar processes.

• Knowledge of GxP, technical documentation and regulated quality processes.

• Experience with CMMS systems such as PEMAC and quality systems such as Veeva Quality is an advantage.

• Experience with RCM (reliability centred maintenance) is an advantage.

As a person, you are proactive, structured and solution-oriented. You enjoy troubleshooting, can manage several tasks at the same time, and are motivated by collaborating across departments to find practical and compliant solutions. You communicate with confidence, build trust with stakeholders and contribute to a positive, LEAN-oriented culture. Working with an optimisation perspective and a focus towards improvements.

**

Your new team**

You will join Maintenance Support at Site Ballerup. We are a team that plays an important role in securing stable technical operations and compliant maintenance. We work closely with Operational Maintenance, Engineering, production areas and laboratories, and we support both daily operations and strategic site changes. Together, we are helping LEO Pharma close one chapter in a responsible way while preparing for the next generation of innovative production.

**

Contact and application**

For additional information, please contact Adam Lundsby Rejkjaer, Senior Team Leader, Maintenance Support at BDYDK@leo-pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact.  Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

Join us in this role where you’ll develop actionable trading views across European power markets, with a focus on North-West Europe and the UK. Working directly with our Senior Trader on the Revenue Desk, you’ll turn fundamental market analysis into strategic recommendations that shape our hedging and proprietary trading positions on the curve up to 5 years out.

**Welcome to Trading & Revenue

**You’ll be part of Price Forecasting & Analysis, a team of dedicated trading analysts and model developers with diverse backgrounds in commodity market analysis, forecasting, and advanced analytics. We have dedicated model developers, so your focus will be on market research and trading support — not building models from scratch.

We value flexibility, experimentation, and knowledge sharing, working in virtual teams with experienced traders, analysts, meteorologists and other specialists. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we especially encourage women and candidates from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• Developing and communicating actionable trading views on European power markets

• Identifying fundamental shifts - supply/demand, policy, weather, interconnector flows - and translating them into trading recommendations

• Collaborating with internal and external analysts to refine market views

• Collaborating directly with the Senior Trader to refine hedging and prop trading strategies

• Performing deep-dive market research on themes that drive power prices across Europe

• Providing fundamental inputs for our price forecasting models and analytics

• Mentoring and educating colleagues on power market dynamics

• Improving our products including price forecasts and trading signal

• Contributing to growing our trading PnL.

**What makes this role stand out:

**

• Direct P&L impact - your recommendations feed straight into trading decisions, not a report that sits on a shelf

• Close to the action - you sit with the trading desk, not in a back-office analytics function

• Green energy trading - your analysis shapes how a global leader in renewable energy trades power

• Ownership - you’ll have the autonomy to drive your own research agenda and trading views

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• Have extensive, hands on experience providing trading driven market research and recommendations within power markets, gained in a trading house, power utility, bank, hedge fund or equivalent trading environment

• Have a proven track record of supporting hedging and proprietary trading decisions, with demonstrated impact on positioning and results

• Have deep understanding of European power market fundamentals and their interaction with forwards, options, and curve dynamics

• Have strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to form clear, well reasoned market views under uncertainty

• Have the ability to communicate complex analysis into decisive, trader ready recommendations

• Have a Master’s degree in economics, finance, energy, engineering or a related quantitative field or a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA®) designation.

**It would be great if you also have:

**

• Experience with North-Western European power markets specifically

• Familiarity with fundamental power market stack modelling concepts

• Experience mentoring or coaching junior analysts

• A passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing

• Proficiency in Python and experience with statistical analysis and time series analysis.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

• Managing after-sales enquiries and cases

In this role, you'll be juggling multiple tasks and deadlines, often working across different departments. That's why we're looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys finding solutions and isn't afraid to reach out to colleagues when needed.

And don't worry – you won't be doing it alone! You'll be part of a supportive team that's always happy to help. Bring your curiosity, enthusiasm and willingness to learn, and we'll help you with the rest.

Do you fit this profile?

You're a natural problem-solver with a strong understanding of systems and processes, a service-minded approach and plenty of drive. Your educational background is not crucial, but your personal profile is. Therefore, it is a prerequisite that you:

• Speak and write fluent French (perhaps it's even your native language?)

• Have basic written and spoken English skills, as English is our corporate language

• Have experience of working with different systems (you may already be familiar with Microsoft CRM or BC365)

• Understands customers' needs and knows how to adapt their communication to different situations

It would also be a bonus if you:

• Have experience with EDI

• Speak and write Italian

Good to know

The position is full-time and requires on-site attendance, with working hours from 8-16 Monday to Thursday and 8-15.30 on Fridays.

Ready to join us?

Send your CV and a short, tailored application to HR@aduro.dk, with "Customer Supporter – French” in the subject line. Tell us why you are a good fit for the position and what motivates you to apply for the job.

We're looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, but we're happy to wait for the right person. Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so don't wait too long to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Customer Service Manager, Helle Kammer Riis, on +45 60 11 05 71.

About Aduro

At Aduro, we develop, manufacture and market wood-burning stoves, pellet stoves, hybrid stoves and bioethanol fireplaces, all combining innovative technology with modern Danish design. Today, we're proud to be among Europe's five largest wood-burning stove manufacturers, exporting 90% of our production.

Innovation is at the heart of what we do. Several of our products are patented, and we're constantly working to develop new solutions that push the boundaries of our industry.

Sollten wir Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz sein?

At Aduro, you'll join a growing, dynamic company with a strong entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in sharing ideas, taking responsibility and helping each other succeed. Our working environment is informal and collaborative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

We're proud of what we've achieved along the way. We've received the prestigious Gazelle Award seven times, recognising our strong growth. In 2024, we were also finalists for EY's Entrepreneur of the Year award and won the SME Inspiration Award in the Internationalisation category for our international outlook.

At our headquarters, you'll become part of an international team representing seven different nationalities. Different cultures and perspectives come together in an energetic workplace where ambition, teamwork and a good sense of humour go hand in hand. We offer modern facilities, social activities, a company lunch scheme and opportunities to develop your skills and take on new challenges.

Great code is only half the job

Cadpeople is hiring a frontend developer in Aarhus who writes solid code, understands the client, designs the system, and makes it feel right.

For 30 years, we've made the complex simple for companies like Vestas, Ørsted, Grundfos, Novo Nordisk and Fred. Olsen. We do it with 3D, XR, digital training simulators, virtual campuses, and digital learning, all built on our in-house frameworks.

The craft is changing too. AI tools already have a big impact on how we develop, and we're on a journey to strengthen our AI coding capabilities. But AI only pays off in the hands of developers with real knowledge and experience. That's why we look for systems thinking, client dialogue, and close collaboration with our creatives, as much as we do code.

What you'll do

You'll build bespoke applications for large enterprise clients, from the first workshop to the live solution. Typical work:

• Turn client needs into systems. Join client meetings and workshops, ask the right questions, and shape the solution before anyone writes code.

• Think across frameworks. Combine our in-house building blocks (Vue.js and Three.js frontends, Digital simulators, Umbraco headless CMS, .NET microservices on Azure, and Electron for offline use) into the right architecture for each case.

• Use what we've already built. Draw on experience from delivered projects to show the client what's possible, and to avoid building the same thing twice.

• Help shape how we build with AI. Use AI tools in your daily work, and help us strengthen our AI coding capabilities as we go.

• Work closely with creatives. Art directors, 3D artists, learning specialists, and project managers are your daily team. You make their ideas run in the browser, on a kiosk, or in a headset.

• Strengthen the foundation. Improve the frameworks on which every future project stands.

Who you are

We don't expect you to know it all. But you'll recognise yourself in most of this:

• You have at least 3 years of experience as a frontend developer, with solid JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue.js skills.

• You think in systems, not just screens: APIs, data, hosting, security and how it all fits together.

• You use AI coding tools fluently, and you still understand, review, and own every line that ships.

• You can explain technical choices to a client who isn't technical, in English. Danish is a plus.

• You care about how things look and feel, and you enjoy working with designers and 3D artists.

• You think big. A request for "an e-learning module" makes you wonder whether it should be a simulator, a virtual campus, or an AI coach.

• It's a plus if you know Three.js, WebGL, Umbraco, Node.js, .NET, Azure, CI/CD and security by design (OWASP Top 10).

Your education matters less than your curiosity and how well you work with others.

What you get

• Work that matters. Train wind turbine technicians, onboard energy workers, and help industrial companies explain products that change the world, often with a sustainability angle.

• Big clients, small team. Enterprise-scale projects with the speed and closeness of a 50-person agency in Aarhus and Edinburgh.

• A global parent with reach. Cadpeople is part of RelyOn, a global safety and training provider with more than 50 facilities worldwide. That gives us stability, new clients, and the chance to see your work train people in safety-critical jobs around the world.

• A head start on every project. Our own tested frameworks mean you start from a solid foundation, not a blank page.

• A say in what comes next. We're building up our AI coding capabilities, and this role can help shape how we get there.

• A creative workplace. An office in the heart of Aarhus, surrounded by people who make 3D, film, XR and learning. See our culture.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short application. A classic application is welcome, as long as it sounds like you. Generic AI-written applications will not be prioritised.

Want to stand out? You can add something small that shows your character and how you'd fit in at Cadpeople. It's optional, and it doesn't need to be big or complex. For example:

• A story about a time you turned a vague client need into something that worked.

• A short video, even filmed on your phone, about something you built or care about.

• A skill or tool, like a small AI agent, workflow or utility you made to work smarter.

• A thought on one of our cases: what you'd have done differently, or how you'd take it further.

Our office language is Danish, and we use English with many of our clients. You don't need to be fluent in Danish, but it helps if you understand it.

Questions about the role? Contact Nikolaj Have, CTO, at nikolaj.have@cadpeople.dk.

Start as soon as possible, or by agreement. All applications are treated confidentially, and submitted material is deleted after 6 months in line with GDPR.

**About The Company

**Founded in 2019, Novutech is a dynamic digital transformation partner with a team of over 60 consultants across Europe. We specialize in finance-focused digital transformation projects for international scale-ups and mid-sized enterprises. Our expertise lies in leveraging a core tech stack and the experience from hundreds of successful projects. We are committed to designing, delivering, and supporting end-to-end solutions that drive growth and efficiency.

**About The Role

**As a Senior Business Consultant, you will play a key role in delivering impactful digital transformation projects for our clients. Leveraging your NetSuite expertise, you will lead complex implementations, oversee advanced configurations, and act as a trusted advisor. You will also mentor junior consultants and progressively develop your people management skills, with the opportunity to lead your own team in the future.

• Lead and execute end-to-end NetSuite implementation projects, from requirements gathering to go-live and post-implementation support.

• Oversee advanced NetSuite configurations and customizations to meet customer needs, acting as a Subject Matter Expert.

• Configure, customize, and optimize NetSuite modules according to client needs.

• Monitor, test, validate, and resolve advanced problems in NetSuite areas.

• Maintain and document high-level processes and complex customizations for external stakeholders.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing best practices and recommendations.

• Support change management and user adoption initiatives.

• Manage overall relationships as Customer Success Manager for medium to large customers, handling tickets, organizing calls, and ensuring quality.

• Contribute to project planning, scoping, and estimation activities, collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders to ensure project success.

• Participate in sales and presales activities as an expert.

• Mentor and supervise business and tech analysts, providing guidance, feedback, and supporting their development through activities such as regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career growth planning, while ensuring high standards in methodology and consulting practices.

• Act as the right hand of the Manager or Director, upholding company values and amplifying leadership messages.

• Contribute to internal projects fostering innovation and growth through entrepreneurial ideas and OKRs.

• Stay updated on NetSuite developments and actively share knowledge with the team.

Why joining Novutech?

• Be part of a fast-growing company with a startup spirit, and enjoy a friendly environment with tremendous colleagues and a hybrid work setup.

• Experience a place where you can grow, learn, and make a significant impact.

• Benefit from a good work-life balance, fostering both personal and professional well-being.

• Enjoy international exposure by collaborating closely with colleagues across our global offices, enriching your professional experience and broadening your cultural understanding.

• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in NetSuite consulting, implementation, or administration.

• Proven track record of successful NetSuite implementations and advanced configuration.

• Strong understanding of business processes (Finance, Accounting, Operations, etc.).

• Experience working in a consulting environment or with multiple clients.

• Demonstrated experience in mentoring, coaching, or supervising junior team members.

• Customer Success Management experience is a plus.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to build strong client relationships.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with attention to detail.

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative, international team.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and drive for continuous improvement.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of French or Dutch is a plus.

• Willingness to travel occasionally within Europe as required.

If you are excited about the opportunity to make a difference and grow with us, we want to hear from you! Join Novutech and be part of an adventure that’s shaping the future of digital transformation.

Since our inception in 2015 in Denmark, Liva has been a pioneer in the field of digital behaviour change. Our ambition is to empower 1 million people by 2030 to improve their health and well-being by preventing and managing chronic conditions through digitally-powered, evidence-based lifestyle interventions.

Headquartered in Copenhagen and London, our collaborations with healthcare systems - including the NHS, life science companies and health insurers - allow us to impact lives at scale. We recently acquired Momenta, a leading developer and provider of evidence-based, outcome driven, healthy lifestyle solutions that help people negotiate the many day-to-day challenges they face in living healthier lives, with a focus on weight management.

This role is working for Diaetisthuset - Part of the Liva Healthcare Group. The Clinical Operations Administrator keeps Diætisthuset's clinics running smoothly day to day. The role combines customer service, clinic operations and the administrative ownership of our medical weight loss programme.

You will be the go-to person for our dietitians and the link between clients, clinicians, our doctor and Liva's wider teams. You will work closely with the dietitian who leads the clinical consultations in the programme, while you own the process around them.

**Key Responsibilities

****Customer service

**

• Handle client enquiries by phone and email in fixed time slots (approx. 15 hours/week on the phone and 5 hours/week on email)

• Provide backup on the phones and take over primary phone coverage when our customer service lead is absent

• Triage medical questions from clients and refer them to the right dietitian

**Clinic operations and administration

**

• Carry out daily, weekly and monthly controlling for finance and operations, in cooperation with the finance team and the Head of Operations, Diætisthuset

• Provide technical system support to colleagues and act as super user in AW

• Handle manual processes related to the integration between AW and Gecko during the ongoing migration

• Be the day-to-day go-to person for our dietitians on practical and system questions

**Medical weight loss programme administration

**

• Own the programme process end to end, including the dialogue with our doctor

• Manage evaluation questionnaires for clients in active programmes (approx. 300 clients, each completing a questionnaire every 4 weeks)

• Order blood tests for clients in the programme

• Work closely with the dietitian responsible for onboarding and status consultations, who owns the clinical side

**Who You'll Work With

**

• Head of Operations, Diætisthuset – your line manager

• Customer service – sharing phone and email coverage

• Dietitians – day-to-day support, including the dietitian leading the medical weight loss consultations

• Finance – controlling and follow-up

• Our doctor – ongoing dialogue on the medical weight loss programme

• Liva's wider teams – including Customer Success and People

**What We're Looking For

**

• Solid experience in administration, customer service or clinic operations

• Strong system skills and confidence learning new tools (e.g. AW, Gecko)

• A strong service mindset towards clients, partners and colleagues

• Structured and able to work independently, with an eye for detail in controlling and follow-up

• Experience with healthcare administration or medical weight loss programmes is an advantage; a clinical background is not required

• Fluent Danish and English, written and spoken

_At Liva, we are a purpose-driven company; we go to work every day to help people live better lives. Our purpose is in our DNA, and we are always on the lookout for talented people eager to evolve and build a life-changing career within global health tech.

__We believe in doing business the right way. Liva is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our workforce. We're committed to developing a representative workforce at all levels, and maintaining a working environment that promotes the health and wellbeing of our employees.

_Liva will operate a fair, inclusive and transparent recruitment and selection process. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout our interview process please let us know and will be happy to accommodate.

**Do you enjoy turning complex technical data into insights that drive better products and smarter decisions? Are you passionate about combining data science with engineering and domain expertise to solve real-world challenges? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

As our Lead Engineer, Data Science, you’ll play a key role in transforming product, sensor and operational data into meaningful insights that support innovation, energy efficiency and data-driven decision-making across Danfoss Climate Solutions.

Working closely with business teams, engineers and data platform specialists, you’ll combine strong analytical capabilities with engineering and domain knowledge to identify high-value opportunities, shape AI and analytics use cases and help build a robust, AI-ready data foundation for future intelligent solutions.

• Good understanding of modern data and ML environments, including cloud platforms and the machine learning lifecycle

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, data and business teams

jobs.occupation: Senior Cyber Security Partner - Enterprise IT
jobs.description:
Job description

Location

Ballerup, Denmark

Job category

Digital & IT

Department: Enterprise IT & Quality

Location: Ballerup

We are looking for a Senior Cyber Security Partner to join our team to support Enterprise IT .

Your impact begins here

As a Senior Cyber Security Partner, you will be the trusted security advisor for Enterprise IT. You will help ensure that cyber security is built into how your area works, makes decisions and develops.

You will translate current and emerging cyber risks into clear, practical advice, contribute to cyber security strategy, and build a strong partnership between your business area and central Cyber Security organisation. Your work will help protect the systems, technology, and data that Novo depends on to drive change for lasting health. Supporting Enterprise IT, you will work closely with your business area to understand its priorities, technology landscape and risk profile, adapting security guidance to its specific needs.

What you’ll bring

You combine broad cyber security expertise with a strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and the ability to build trust, connect security risk to business objectives, and move the business forward.

For the position supporting Enterprise IT, we are looking for experience advising on cyber security risks across enterprise applications and IT infrastructure, including cloud services, identity and access management, end user devices and networks.

This position requires the ability to translate cyber security risks into practical advice and support informed business decisions.

You will bring:

• 5–10 years of relevant experience within cyber security, information security, IT risk or related disciplines in a large or complex organisation.

• A strong understanding of IT and/or OT and the ability to connect security to business objectives.

• Experience with security frameworks such as NIST CSF or ISO 27001.

• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with your assigned area.

• Very good interpersonal, communication and coaching skills.

• The ability to collaborate and communicate with external parties such as vendors, consultants and authorities.

• A master’s or bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline.

• Full professional proficiency in English. Danish language skills may be an advantage but are not a requirement.

Useful, but not essential:

• Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM or CISA.

What you’ll do

You will be the go-to security partner for your assigned area: the person who translates threats and frameworks into practical advice that supports informed decisions and helps teams act on them with confidence.

• Act as the cyber security partner for Enterprise IT driving collaboration between your assigned business area and other security professionals.

• Provide expert advice on current and future security threats, translating risk into clear priorities your stakeholders can act on.

• Help stakeholders understand cyber risks, available options and appropriate mitigations, enabling informed, risk-based decisions.

• Support and contribute to cyber security strategies, making sure they reflect the realities and objectives of your assigned area.

• Promote and establish a strong relationship between your assigned area and Cyber Security, so security is considered early rather than added late.

• Work with external parties, including vendors, consultants and authorities, to keep security work moving forward.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Security Partners team within Cyber Risk and Resilience, working alongside eight colleagues serving as Security Partners and Business Information Security Officers (BISOs).

In your assigned area, you will provide trusted, risk-based cyber security leadership and help embed security into business and technology decisions.

Your closest partners may include:

• Data, process, business and contract owners

• IT system managers

• Managers, subject matter experts, architects and process teams

• Domain and enterprise architects

• Colleagues across Enterprise IT

• Cyber Security colleagues and other relevant specialist functions

Bringing these perspectives together, you will create clarity on security priorities, speak up when things stall and help teams make decisions they can own and follow through on. You will report to Erling Jepsen, Director.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to lead on security for areas that matter to how Novo works today and develops new treatments for tomorrow. Your expertise will be valued, your voice will be heard, and your advice will shape real decisions.

You will work with skilled security professionals, architects and partners across IT, OT and research, building your skills through practical, cross-functional experience. You will be supported to perform at your best, with honest feedback and clear expectations, in a team that combines curiosity, collaboration, and ambition.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000.00 to  1,245,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits

The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

If you are ready to become a trusted cyber security partner for Enterprise IT we would like to hear from you. Please indicate in your application if you have a particular interest in, or experience relevant to, either of the two areas.

Apply for the Senior Cyber Security Partner role by 30/10/2026.

For further information, please contact Erling Jepsen at (+45) 30759351.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Sr Business Operations Manager

Department: GMA Business Operations

Location: Søborg, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As Sr Business Operations Manager, you will help Global Medical Affairs (GMA) leadership make clearer, faster decisions on strategy, budget and priorities. You will advise senior leaders, lead complex projects where the problem is not yet defined, and co-own a key process that GMA teams rely on. Your work turns ambiguity into decisions, so medical affairs colleagues can focus their time and resources where they matter most for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

• Master’s degree in business, finance, sciences, engineering or a similar field.

• 5–7 years of relevant experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic projects and owning process improvement in a complex organisation.

• Experience leading financial planning and budget processes, challenging financial assumptions and aligning Finance and senior stakeholders around priorities and decisions.

• A proven ability to frame ambiguous problems, influence senior leaders, guide contributors and turn analysis into decisions.

• Excellent executive communication, strategic judgement and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without authority and sustain alignment across senior stakeholder groups.

• Cultural awareness and adaptability, and a collaborative way of coaching colleagues.

What you’ll do

Your role combines three connected workstreams: partnering with GMA leaders, owning the budget process and leading projects. Together, they help GMA work with more clarity and speed.

• Advise the head of your assigned GMA area on the annual strategy process and its translation into budget priorities, framing trade-offs and challenging assumptions, dependencies and options.

• Co-own the budget process area with a team colleague, setting direction for templates, guidance and best practice, and leading adoption across GMA.

• Lead highly complex and ambiguous strategic projects: frame the problem, define scope and governance, set milestones and risk responses, and deliver on time, within budget and to the required quality.

• Strengthen governance by clarifying decisions, accountability and follow-up across interdependent work.

• Turn evidence into concise, data-driven recommendations, and prepare analyses, memos and presentations that shape GMA Leadership Team decisions.

• Share what you learn, improve common team methods and mentor colleagues, so the team stays resilient and consistent.

Who you’ll work with

You will join GMA Business Operations in Product & Portfolio Strategy, where colleagues connect commercial strategy, medical affairs and business development across therapy areas to help guide the Novo portfolio and strengthen competitiveness. You will report to the Director, GMA Business Operations, and work closely with your team colleagues to ensure success across the unit.

Your day-to-day partners include the GMA Leadership Team, leaders and specialists across GMA and medical affairs worldwide, Finance partner, and colleagues in Strategy, Executive Office and PMO functions. You will also have occasional contact with external parties.

The role is global in scope, with stakeholders across the world and minimal travel expected. Your influence comes from building trust, creating clarity and aligning functions whose priorities may differ.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to define your own approach to complex, unclear assignments, with minimal guidance and room to make your voice heard at senior level. You will grow by working across GMA and supporting functions, learning from colleagues and sharing your expertise through mentoring and strategic sparring.

We expect high standards and honest, direct conversations, and we support you to perform at your best.

As Software Asset Management (Lead/Senior), you will build Software Asset Management into an enterprise-wide capability that Novo governs and owns internally. You will connect entitle-ment, usage, contract and financial data so teams can make sharper investment decisions, ne-gotiate from evidence and simplify the technology landscape. Your work will turn software com-plexity into savings validated by Finance, lower risk and budget released for new priorities, giv-ing colleagues across Novo more room to focus on the work that matters.

What you’ll bring

You know enterprise software licensing well, from contract terms to deployment data, and you can turn that knowledge into decisions people trust. You will also bring:

· A relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience.

· Proven experience in building or maturing Software Asset Management or IT Asset Manage-ment governance and operating models in a complex organisation.

· Deep knowledge of complex software licensing, product-use rights, entitlement reconcilia-tion, effective licence positions, audit readiness and compliance risk.

· A solid understanding of SaaS, cloud marketplace, BYOL, AI and consumption-based com-mercial models.

· Experience with software sourcing, contract interpretation, vendor management and negoti-ations, supported by FinOps, cost transparency, forecasting and benefits tracking.

Hands-on experience with SAM and ITAM platforms such as Flexera One or similar, and an understanding of ServiceNow, CMDB, identity, discovery and endpoint-management tools.

· Strong data, analytics and reporting skills, with the ability to combine financial, contractual, technical and risk information into clear recommendations.

· The ability to influence without formal authority, guide people through new ways of working, and explain technical and contractual complexity in clear business terms to any audience.

· A pragmatic, accountable approach that keeps progress moving when information is incomplete.

Useful, but not essential:

· SAM, ITAM, FinOps, ITIL or vendor-specific certifications.

· Experience with application rationalisation and technology lifecycle management.

· Experience applying automation or governed AI to contract analysis, forecasting or decision support.

What you’ll do

You will set the direction and stay hands-on enough to speed up delivery. Success means clear accountabilities, repeatable cycles and value that Finance can confirm.

· Define and implement the SAM vision, mandate, governance, policies, controls and multi-year roadmap, with clear decision rights across technology, Procurement, Finance, Security and business owners.

· Build recurring processes for licence positions, compliance, audit readiness, optimisation and renewal preparation, so that risks are found and fixed early.

· Turn usage, entitlement, consumption and contract data into rightsizing, reclamation, con-solidation and application-rationalisation actions that improve licence utilisation and reduce redundant or unmanaged software.

· Run a transparent value pipeline covering realised savings, cost avoidance, risk reduction and budget release, and strengthen sourcing strategies and vendor negotiations with evi-dence that holds up.

· Own the business requirements and governance for SAM data, tooling, integrations, data quality and reporting, and connect SAM with FinOps, ITAM, Enterprise Architecture and lifecycle management across on-premises, SaaS, cloud and AI models.

· Apply automation and governed AI to improve efficiency and forecasting, and lead cross-functional initiatives and external specialists while building the internal knowledge Novo needs to depend less on individuals and outside providers.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Enterprise IT & Quality, where colleagues work across the Novo value chain, stay close to stakeholders and help deliver trusted technology and responsible ways of working. You will report to Anders Gooseman Hove.

Your closest partners will be Enterprise IT leadership, Procurement and Strategic Sourcing, and Finance and FinOps. You will also work with Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Legal, ServiceNow and CMDB teams, cloud and platform teams, and application and product owners. Outside Novo, you will work with software vendors and specialist external advisers.

Each partner owns part of the software picture. You will bring them together around shared data and clear decisions and speak up when things stall.

What you can expect here

You will have the trust and space to shape a capability across the enterprise. Your expertise will inform investment, sourcing and architecture decisions, and you will be expected to make your voice heard and then commit once decisions are made.

The role puts you at the point where technology, commercial and financial work meet, giving you broad exposure across the value chain. As Novo upskills its workforce to make AI a main driver of innovation, you will help shape how governed AI improves the way software is man-aged. You can expect clear performance expectations, honest feedback and a culture that rec-ognises results.

At Novo Nordisk, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong re-sults. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

Do you have a passion for pharmaceutical quality, but also believe that Quality should be about more than compliance?

At Fertin Pharma, we develop and manufacture pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products in partnership with leading global and regional brands, combining pharmaceutical expertise with innovative oral delivery technologies.

We are looking for a QA Specialist who wants to work close to our pharmaceutical operations and help us ensure the quality of our products and continuously strengthen the way we manufacture. You will become part of an environment where GMP, manufacturing, and continuous improvement come together.

About the role:

As QA Specialist, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality and Operations. Your role will combine day-to-day quality activities with investigation, problem solving, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to influence how we work with quality and help move from simply reacting to quality issues towards preventing them through stronger processes and effective collaboration. Your responsibilities may include:

• Supporting and approving deviation investigations, including root-cause analysis and CAPAs

• Participating in the release process of our pharmaceutical products

• Providing GMP and quality support to pharmaceutical manufacturing

• Reviewing and approving manufacturing documentation

• Participating in change controls, risk assessments, and quality improvement activities

• Contributing to the simplification of our Quality Management System

• Supporting inspection and audit readiness

• Participating in cross-functional projects where quality expertise is needed

Who are you?

Your exact educational background is less important than your ability to understand processes, challenge constructively and turn complex quality issues into practical solutions. We imagine that you:

• Have a relevant scientific, engineering, or pharmaceutical background

• Preferably have experience from pharmaceutical or other highly regulated industry

• It would be considered a strong advantage if your educational background and professional experience meet the requirements for acting as a delegated Qualified Person (QP Delegate) according to Danish requirements

• Understand GMP and preferably have practical experience working within a pharmaceutical Quality Management System

• Can balance compliance, risk and operational reality

• Have experience with, or an interest in, deviations, CAPA, root-cause analysis and risk management

• Is curious and comfortable asking why

• Communicate clearly and collaborate naturally across functions

If you are motivated by making quality work in practice, not simply administering it, we would like to hear from you. Send your cover letter and CV as soon as possible via the link below. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.
